## What this changes



## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` reports no errors, and I have looked at each warning
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] `npm test` passes

For a new or changed guide:

- [ ] It solves one problem
- [ ] Its commands are run by a test, or each one that is not is marked `manual` with a reason
- [ ] Warnings come before any command that can lose work or change history
- [ ] `verified` is updated only if I checked every step, manual ones included
- [ ] It contains no secrets, personal details or internal information
